tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condition as per tender RFP
The right to accept or reject or postpone or change or cancel the tender without citing any reasons and to take final decision vests with Chief Executive Officer, KVIB, and Bengaluru.

The contract shall be governed by KTPP Act-1999 and its Rules-2000 and other laws of India and all Government rules on this matter issued from time to time and in force for the time being are applicable to this contract tender.

The Agency is responsible for statutory payment of E.S.I., P.F. Service etc., to the respective authorities and the agency should pay the statutory payments to the concerned authorities within 15 days from the date of receipt of monthly fee and produce the copies of the challans to the Board to enable to consider their succeeding month bills.
The persons provided as outsource service basis by the agency have no claims whatever on the Karnataka State Khadi and Village Industries Board, Jasma Bhavan Road, Bengaluru-52
The Agency should agree to the terms and conditions imposed by the board from time to time

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have the minimum 03 years experience in performing similar kind of work, of which one year in Government Department/agencies
The agency must be a registered partnership/private/public limited company. The agencies run by proprietors having good reputation in the market will be considered on merits
Acknowledgment of IT Returns for the last 3 years shall be uploaded along with the application.
Minimum period of existence of agency shall be 3 years. Copies of the statutory licenses obtained by the agency should be clearly stated in their application and to be uploaded.
The agency should have been registered with the following statutory ESI authorities PF authorities Income Tax authorities GST Labour Department of Registration

The Annual turnover of the agency shall be Rs.100 lakh (Rupees one Crore Only) per Annum in the last preceding 03 years. Financial Statement showing the Turnover duly certified by the Chartered Accountant should be submitted.
